title: Levelrail announcement item
description: One announcement file under announcements/YYYY/<id>.json. The file name without .json must equal id, and the folder year must equal the year of issued_at. tools/announce validate enforces everything here plus the content rules that JSON Schema cannot express.

id.description: Stable unique id, lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 3 to 80 characters. Convention: YYYY-MM-DD-short-slug. An id never comes back once it left the feed.

tier.description: critical: both security keys must sign, root only, cannot be dismissed while it applies. advisory: one security key, root only. feature, maintenance, info, newsletter: the CI key may sign, shown to every signed in user.

kind.description: announcement is normal content. revoke_key marks key revoke_key_id as revoked on instances and must be tier critical.

title.description: Plain text, one line, at most 120 characters. No HTML, no markdown links.

body.description: At most 2000 characters. Markdown subset: paragraphs, **bold**, *em*, inline code, '-' lists and [text](https://allowlisted-url) links. No HTML, images, fenced code blocks, shell commands, secrets or non allowlisted links.

applies_to.description: Semver range over the instance version, space or comma separated constraints with <, <=, >, >=, = (for example '>=1.5.0 <1.5.14'). Required for critical and advisory. A wildcard or a range that matches nothing is rejected.

channels.description: Update channels the item targets. Empty or missing means all.

requires_flags.description: Optional feature flags that must be on for the instance to see the item.

cta.description: Internal route for the call to action. Never a URL. Newsletter items cannot carry one.

links.description: At most 5 links. https only; host levelrail.com, or github.com under /glincker/. No query string, fragment, port or credentials.

i18n.description: Optional translations keyed by language tag. English title and body stay required and are the fallback. Translations obey the same content rules.

revoke_key_id.description: Only for kind revoke_key: the key id to revoke.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 time the item was written. Not in the future.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 time after which instances stop showing the item. After issued_at and at most 366 days later.
